title: Krasteline
dek: A crafter who investigates the Gate, helps Fenwick to his feet and tries to keep her companions looking forward.

facts.Recorded at: The Gate and road to Pristinia

sources: Gate chronicle · selected arrival and welcome scenes; January 2024–September 2026 posting records
body:
A craft carried into exile

Krasteline introduces herself as a former main crafter for rebels and says she still tries to craft. She names Sago as her home. She retains old gauntlets that no longer work; the scene does not establish their full history or a means of repair.

Helping the next arrival

With Kasiri, she examines the Gate, then offers Fenwick a hand when he arrives disoriented. She encourages the others to keep their chins up and smile, while acknowledging that this place remains hard and dangerous. Her mention of Alyndra is a hope or question, not proof that Alyndra is somewhere in Fenumion.
